text:
secrets-scan-bot: ALERT: automated repo scan found 3 private GCP service account keys embedded in code. Paths: private/infra/terraform/main.tf, ml/serving/legacy_loader.py, ops/old_deploy/scripts/deploy.sh. Severity: HIGH. See findings: https://scans.internal/redwood/2081234567 

samir (security): Thanks for the flag. Tagging owners @ellie and @oscar. Immediate action: rotate affected keys, delete old keys, remove secrets from repos, and update secret store. Target: key rotation completed in 24h, public removal in 48h, full audit in 72h.

ellie (platform): Acknowledged. I will start rotations for infra and ml SAs. Will create PRs to purge files and push secrets to Vault. Which service accounts specifically?

samir (security): Affected service accounts: infra-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, ml-serving@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, legacy-deploy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Runbook (minimal):
```
# create new key and store it
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=infra-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# upload to vault/secretsmanager
vault kv put secret/redwood/infra-ci key=@new-key.json
# delete old key (get key id from keys list)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete OLD_KEY_ID --iam-account=infra-ci@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# remove file from git history
git filter-repo --path private/infra/terraform/main.tf --invert-paths
```

oscar (eng-sre): Heads up: removing keys may require rolling a small set of infra services. I'll coordinate a short maintenance window and watch for auth errors. Please list any services that need creds updated immediately.

maya (product-security): Also require: 1) create a ticket in IC for audit trail (IC-2081), 2) tighten IAM bindings for these SAs to least privilege, avoid owner/editor roles, 3) add conditional bindings where possible. We'll validate post-rotation.

ryan (infra): I'll run an IAM roles dump and policy analyzer to find overly broad bindings, then open PRs to narrow roles. Quick commands I ran: 
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > prod-iam.json
gcloud asset analyze-iam-policy --analysis-query="scope=projects/redwood-prod" --output-path=iam-analysis.json
```

samir (security): Good. Also add immediate CI checks to catch reintroductions: enable git-secrets and pre-commit hook in affected repos, and add regex-based rules to our scan tool. I want a blocker on merging until scan passes for 7 days.

ellie (platform): Creating PRs now: 1) purge embedded keys + history rewrite, 2) move rotated keys into Vault and update deploy agents to read from Vault. PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/422, https://git.internal/redwood/ml/pull/183. I'll post status updates in this thread.

secrets-scan-bot: STATUS UPDATE: findings assigned to ellie (platform). Remediation status: IN_PROGRESS.

oscar (eng-sre): Noted. Scheduling maintenance window 2026-03-24 02:00-02:30 UTC to swap infra creds and monitor. Will notify pager duty.

samir (security): Timeline recap: rotations done within 24h, repo purge and CI hardening within 48h, audit & IAM tightening within 72h. If anybody hits blockers, escalate in this thread and ping me. :exclamation: :lock: 

ellie (platform): Rotation started, PRs opened, history rewrite queued. Will update when keys are deleted and services validated. :white_check_mark:

secrets-scan-bot: Final note: CI rule added to block commits containing base64-encoded rsa key headers. Will monitor for 7 days and report regressions.
